# AgentOS Repository Labels

This document defines the standard GitHub labels for the AgentOS repository.
Create these labels in your GitHub repository settings.

## Bug Labels

| Label | Color | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| `bug` | `#d73a4a` | Something isn't working |
| `regression` | `#e11d48` | Worked before, broken now |
| `critical-bug` | `#7f1d1d` | Production-blocking issue |

## Feature Labels

| Label | Color | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| `enhancement` | `#a2eeef` | New feature or improvement |
| `new-profile` | `#0075ca` | Request for a new project profile |
| `new-agent` | `#0075ca` | Request for a new specialist agent |
| `new-standard` | `#0075ca` | Request for a new engineering standard |

## Quality Labels

| Label | Color | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| `documentation` | `#0075ca` | Documentation improvement |
| `validator` | `#6f42c1` | Validator improvement |
| `performance` | `#f9d0c4` | Performance improvement |
| `security` | `#ee0701` | Security-related issue |

## Workflow Labels

| Label | Color | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| `needs-triage` | `#ededed` | Needs initial assessment |
| `needs-reproduction` | `#ededed` | Bug needs steps to reproduce |
| `needs-design` | `#fbca04` | Requires architectural design |
| `in-progress` | `#0075ca` | Actively being worked on |
| `blocked` | `#e4e669` | Blocked on external dependency |
| `question` | `#d876e3` | Further information requested |
| `wontfix` | `#ffffff` | Will not be addressed |
| `duplicate` | `#cfd3d7` | Duplicate of another issue |

## Version Labels

| Label | Color | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| `v1.0.x` | `#0e8a16` | Affects current stable release |
| `v1.1.0-planned` | `#5319e7` | Planned for next minor release |
| `breaking-change` | `#b60205` | Would require a major version bump |
